writer.short_answer: One of the three hashtags shows several signs of coordination, one looks organic and one is mixed, and none of the indicators says who is behind them.

claims.text: NaijaDecides is flagged: of 120 posts, 74 were near duplicates, 58 landed inside one ten minute window, and 41 of the 90 accounts were recently created.
claims.label: corroborated

quotes.text: Our future, our vote, our voice

claims.text: EnoughIsEnough looks organic, with 9 near duplicates among 140 posts and a spread of different wording, at medium confidence.
claims.label: corroborated

claims.text: BridgeBuilders is mixed, with 23 near duplicates among 60 posts, mostly from accounts that also post about other things.
claims.label: corroborated
